claim: Same-mesh numerical agreement does not establish continuum accuracy; all studied joint mesh/geometry tails remain unresolved
selected_case: Opposing declared0.05N finite compact profiles, radius3mm, friction2; fixed per-mesh inputs for all four models
caption: Three useful levels on six complete3D shapes. The first figure retains every unaveraged global four-corner von Mises peak. The second reports adjacent full-tensor changes at fixed physical interior probes; the first level has no adjacent value. The dotted3% line is the declared initial tail diagnostic. No complete peak/energy/tensor/von-Mises tail passes. These curves combine geometry and volume refinement. The narrow-gap pressure curve is a numerically qualified solution with inadmissible local traction, not a validated physical prediction.
alt_text: Two six-panel figures show raw peak curves and large nonmonotone full-tensor refinement changes for four load models and independent FEM
